about: A self-hosted tracker for workouts, nutrition and body weight.

prs.title: Nutrition diary pages no longer repeat or skip entries
prs.broken: Food logged at the same time had no fixed order, so paging through the nutrition diary could show some entries twice and miss others.
prs.changed: Entries with the same time are now also sorted by when they were added.
prs.matters: Apps reading a diary page by page get every entry exactly once.
